data.long_description:
Live Above It All – 2-Bedroom Apartment in Burj Khalifa Zone 3 with Full Fountain & Downtown Views

Step into refined luxury with this stunning 2-bedroom residence located in the iconic Burj Khalifa – Zone 3, offering unmatched full views of The Dubai Fountain and the spectacular Downtown Dubai skyline.

Designed with elegance and functionality in mind, this high-floor unit features:

2 Spacious Bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms
Bright, open-plan living area with floor-to-ceiling windows
Breathtaking views of the Fountain show and city skyline
Fully equipped modern kitchen with premium appliances
High-end finishes and impeccable attention to detail

Key Features & Amenities:

Direct access to Dubai Mall via air-conditioned walkway
24/7 Concierge & Security
Indoor & outdoor swimming pools
State-of-the-art gym and fitness facilities
Residents' lounge, library, and business center
Valet parking and dedicated basement parking
Fine dining, retail, and entertainment at your doorstep

Wake up every morning to shimmering fountains and the energy of the city. Whether you’re relaxing with a coffee overlooking the Burj Lake or entertaining with a view that leaves guests speechless, this apartment offers a lifestyle like no other in Dubai.
